newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS optimistic on 1997 after strong H1.
newsitem.headline: UBS optimistic on 1997 after strong H1.

text.p: The Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) said on Tuesday it was optimistic about its performance for the whole of 1997 after net profit in the first half of the year rose 67.4 percent to 1,856 million Swiss francs.

"UBS is optimistic for the current financial year, but it would be rash to believe that conditions in the second half of the year will be as optimal as they were in the first," UBS said in a statement.
"UBS assumes that its group profit for the full year will enable it to achieve its goal of a return on equity of over 12 percent," the bank group added.
